summary: The full popular-model documentation migration already exists in the prepared base through upstream PR #25813. This contribution fixes a regression in that implementation: the deleted qwen3 source page documented Qwen3-Next, but its legacy URL redirected to the generic Qwen3 cookbook page. Both the checked-in Mintlify redirect and its generator now target Qwen3-Next, with regression coverage for the complete migrated route set.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-35da4a187bd0/venv/bin/python -m unittest docs.tests.test_popular_model_redirects (base redirect values, before fix)
tests.what_was_measured: The new regression suite produced two failures proving that /basic_usage/qwen3.html and the generator incorrectly targeted /cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3. Raw output: reports/j-35da4a187bd0/logs/failing-before.txt

Five tests verified all 13 migrated popular-model redirects, source uniqueness, generator/config parity, destination file existence, and removal of the legacy duplicate pages. Raw output: reports/j-35da4a187bd0/logs/passing-after.txt
The redirect generator completed using the corrected mapping. Generated output is retained outside the worktree at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-35da4a187bd0/generated-redirects.txt.
Both changed Python files compile successfully with the prepared interpreter.

gpu_execution_evidence: The change affects only static documentation routing and its test; no model execution, numerical output, or GPU path is involved.
remaining_limitations: The Mintlify CLI is unavailable in the prepared environment, so mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects could not be run; this is recorded in reports/j-35da4a187bd0/logs/mint-broken-links.txt.
No deployed docs.sglang.io instance was modified or tested. Validation covers the repository's Mintlify configuration, redirect generator, and destination files.

The semantic accuracy and model/hardware commands in the already-merged cookbook migration were not requalified with model weights or hardware; this contribution only fixes and locks down the misrouted legacy Qwen3 URL.
